title: mail: Email/set update for mailbox membership (stub)
description:
Implement Email/set update handling of mailboxIds change: since an article's Newsgroups header is immutable, mailbox membership is read-only. Return a notPermitted setError for any update that attempts to change mailboxIds. Other properties (keywords for \Seen/\Flagged) are handled separately in the user-state epic.

Why: clients may try to move messages between folders; a clear error is better than silent failure.

Acceptance: Email/set update with mailboxIds change returns notPermitted; update with keywords-only succeeds (once user-flags are wired).
